name: hud_ui_cycle_selector_widget_apply_font_style_for_entry
description: HudUiCycleSelectorWidget::ApplyFontStyleForEntry grows the entry range, validates a dialog font style, applies the font through the entry virtual SetFont method, and copies text/shadow/background fields.
tier_s_evidence: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4b8100 with VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_facs passes with zero unmasked byte mismatches after COFF relocation masking; BN size 248, VC5 size 256, and 8 trailing VC5 NOP bytes trimmed.
